exposure: Mothers who conceived using assisted treatment
outcome: Exclusivity of breastfeeding at six months
cohort: 100 mothers (55 who conceived using assisted treatment and 45 who conceived naturally) who gave birth to healthy, full-term, singleton infants
finding: The mode of conception (assisted vs. natural) did not significantly influence the likelihood of achieving the goal of 6 months of exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: The mode of conception (assisted vs. natural) did not significantly influence the proportion of mothers exclusively breastfeeding at six months.
